Heavy Duty 5 x 5 Security Stud Hinges

text.description_html:
Deltana SS55BB-SEC, Stainless Steel 5" x 5" Square Corner Heavy Duty Ball Bearing Hinge with Security Stud

This stainless steel 5" door hinge has 2 ball bearings. A heavy duty door hinge, it is .150" thick. These extra security door hinges have locking tabs that protrude into the door jamb and join the 2 hinge leaves together when the door is closed. They hold a closed door in place even if the door hinges are tampered with (if hinge pins are removed or cut).

Features and Specifications of the Heavy Duty 5" x 5" Security Stud Hinge:

  • Hinge Material: 304 Stainless Steel
  • Height: 5 "
  • Width: 5"
  • Corners: Square
  • Thickness: .150" (3.82mm)
  • Ball Bearings: 2BB
  • Hinge Pin: Stainless Steel

No matter which finish you choose, the parts will still be high quality solid Stainless Steel.

Sold as a Pair (2 Hinges)
